bubbles.title: Ability format
bubbles.hint: Decided: folders .bubble-tracks/abilities/*.md (project) + ~/.bubble-tracks/abilities/*.md (user); project wins on name clash. File: frontmatter name (default = filename, invoked as /bubble:<name>), description (one line, for listing), type: bubble|track; then free-text body = workflow run once against bubble/track context.

bubbles.title: Invoke /bubble:<cmd>
bubbles.hint: Works like a harness skills folder: each <ability>.md is discovered and read. It names a command, invoked as /bubble:<cmd>, which applies the ability's doing to the active track or bubble. The file has a type: track|bubble (scope it applies to), then free text (whatever the ability is).

bubbles.title: List abilities
bubbles.hint: CLI command that scans the folder and lists name + description (like skill discovery).

bubbles.title: Context handoff
bubbles.hint: On invoke, CLI prints the ability text + the active bubble (type: bubble) or the whole track (type: track) as the agent's context.

bubbles.title: One-off run
bubbles.hint: Applying is one-off: the agent runs the ability's workflow once against the active bubble's content (type: bubble) or the track's context (type: track). The workflow is open-ended. Examples: 'research' (research what the bubble/track needs; on return the agent may change the track), 'step' (a defined flow the active bubble's implementation follows, e.g. tests or a verification process).

bubbles.title: Fallback support
bubbles.hint: Teach fallback.md (no-node path) how to find, list and apply abilities by hand.

bubbles.title: Skill + docs
bubbles.hint: SKILL.md: when to read/use an applied ability while walking a bubble; README section; tests.

handoff.note: Goal: bubble abilities, like agent skills. A folder of short descriptions and/or skill files that the CLI (and the no-node fallback) watches, and that can be applied to the active bubble.
